# device42_auto_discovery_cloudaccount (Resource)


## Exemple

```hcl
resource "device42_auto_discovery_cloudaccount" "example" {
  name          = "cloudaccount"
  type          = "OpenStack"
  server        = "hostname.domain.local"
  username      = "admin"
  schedule_days = "0,1,2,3,4"
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the cloudaccount autodiscovery job. Create only (the API upserts by name).
- `type` (String) The cloud type (for example `OpenStack`, `Amazon AWS`, `Google Cloud`).

### Optional

- `add_suffix` (String) Whether to add a suffix to discovered names.
- `add_tags_as_custom_fields` (String) Whether to add tags as custom fields.
- `alibaba_regions` (String) Comma separated list of Alibaba cloud regions.
- `aws_roles` (String) Comma separated list of AWS roles to use.
- `collect_db_info` (String) Whether to collect database information.
- `google_regions` (String) Comma separated list of Google Cloud regions.
- `ip` (String) IP of the cloud account server.
- `match_name_only_for_hypervisor` (String) Whether to match names only for hypervisor devices.
- `match_name_only_for_virtuals` (String) Whether to match names only for virtual devices.
- `notes` (String) Notes to attach to the job.
- `object_category` (String) Object category to assign to discovered devices.
- `oracle_regions` (String) Comma separated list of Oracle cloud regions.
- `outscale_regions` (String) Comma separated list of Outscale regions.
- `overwrite_object_category` (String) Whether to overwrite the object category of existing devices.
- `regions` (String) Comma separated list of regions.
- `remove_unfound_instances` (String) Whether to remove instances that are no longer found.
- `schedule_days` (String) Comma separated days of week (Monday = 0).
- `schedule_time` (String) Time in HH:MM format to schedule the job.
- `server` (String) IP or FQDN of the cloud account server.
- `service_level` (String) Service level to assign to discovered devices.
- `strip_domain_name` (String) Whether to strip the domain name from discovered device names.
- `tags` (String) Comma separated list of tags to attach.
- `tenant` (String) Tenant of the cloud account.
- `username` (String) Username to authenticate with.
- `vendor` (String) Vendor of the cloud account.
- `vrf_group` (String) VRF group to assign to discovered devices.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
